# stalwart_mta_sts (Resource)

Configures the MTA-STS policy for the server. This singleton object always exists: creating the resource adopts the current server settings and destroying it only removes the resource from state.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `max_age` (Number) Maximum time to cache the MTA-STS policy
- `mode` (String) Whether to enforce, test, or disable the MTA-STS policy
- `mx_hosts` (Set of String) Override the allowed MX hosts for the MTA-STS policy domain. If empty, the MX hosts are determined from the system settings

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Server-assigned identifier.
